summary: Luckin Coffee filed a Form 6-K announcing its board approved an upsizing of its share repurchase program by US$200 million, increasing the authorized amount from US$300 million to US$500 million. The program, launched in April 2026, covers repurchases of Class A ordinary shares in the form of ADSs through April 29, 2027. As of August 31, 2026, the company had repurchased 71.6 million shares (8.9 million ADSs) for US$287.2 million, nearly exhausting the original authorization. Repurchases will occur on the open market or privately negotiated transactions, subject to Rule 10b-18 and 10b5-1. The board retains discretion to modify or suspend the program. Watch for execution pace and potential further expansions.
